# FortiSOAR Jinja filter reference

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/store/export_jinja_reference.py from fsr_reference.db. Do not edit. -->

Every filter, global and test registered in the FortiSOAR playbook engine, with what each filter
was **proven** to accept and return by rendering it on a live box through
`/api/wf/api/jinja-editor/` (the engine a running playbook uses).

- Evidence: 1032 rendered cases (597 rendered, 435 raised) across 159 of 172 filters.
- Probed on: cyops-workflow-8.0.0-6034.
- "Accepts" lists input types that rendered with no arguments (or the curated case's arguments);
  "Raises on" lists input types that errored. Output types are Python type names from `type_debug`.
- `generator` output is lazy: pipe it through `| list` before indexing or storing it.

## Refreshing this page

```bash
make jinja-export INSTANCE=<alias>   # dump filters/globals/tests + signatures from the box over SSH
make jinja-probe  INSTANCE=<alias>   # render every probe case live, store the evidence
make jinja-docs                      # regenerate this file
make jinja-verify INSTANCE=<alias>   # replay every case; fails if a filter breaks or changes type
```

Add cases for filters with required arguments, or behaviour worth pinning, in
`tooling/probes/jinja_filter_cases.yaml`.

## Filter details

### abs

`abs(x, /)`

Returns the absolute value of a number.

| Case | Input | Args | Result | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| input:bool | `true` |  | `int` | `1` |
| input:dict | `{"b": 2, "a": 1}` |  | raises | `APIError: bad operand type for abs(): 'dict'` |
| input:float | `2.5` |  | `float` | `2.5` |
| input:int | `3` |  | `int` | `3` |
| input:list | `[3, 1, 2]` |  | raises | `APIError: bad operand type for abs(): 'list'` |
| input:none | `null` |  | raises | `APIError: bad operand type for abs(): 'NoneType'` |
| input:str | `"Hello World"` |  | raises | `APIError: bad operand type for abs(): 'str'` |

### attr

`attr(environment: 'Environment', obj: Any, name: str) -> Union[jinja2.runtime.Undefined, Any]`

Returns the named attribute of an object (like obj.name but dynamic).

| Case | Input | Args | Result | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| curated:1 | `{"a": 1}` | `'a'` | `ChainableUndefined` |  |

### b64decode

`b64decode(string, encoding='utf-8')`

Decodes a base64 value

| Case | Input | Args | Result | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| input:bool | `true` |  | raises | `APIError: \n<!doctype html>\n<html lang="en">\n<head>\n  <title>Server Error (500)</title>\n</head>\n<body>\n  <h1>Serve...` |
| input:dict | `{"b": 2, "a": 1}` |  | raises | `APIError: \n<!doctype html>\n<html lang="en">\n<head>\n  <title>Server Error (500)</title>\n</head>\n<body>\n  <h1>Serve...` |
| input:float | `2.5` |  | raises | `APIError: Incorrect padding` |
| input:int | `3` |  | raises | `APIError: Invalid base64-encoded string: number of data characters (1) cannot be 1 more than a multiple of 4` |
| input:list | `[3, 1, 2]` |  | raises | `APIError: Incorrect padding` |
| input:none | `null` |  | raises | `APIError: \n<!doctype html>\n<html lang="en">\n<head>\n  <title>Server Error (500)</title>\n</head>\n<body>\n  <h1>Serve...` |
| input:str | `"Hello World"` |  | raises | `APIError: Incorrect padding` |

### b64encode

`b64encode(string, encoding='utf-8')`

Encodes a value as base64

| Case | Input | Args | Result | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| input:bool | `true` |  | `str` | `VHJ1ZQ==` |
| input:dict | `{"b": 2, "a": 1}` |  | `str` | `eydiJzogMiwgJ2EnOiAxfQ==` |
| input:float | `2.5` |  | `str` | `Mi41` |
| input:int | `3` |  | `str` | `Mw==` |
| input:list | `[3, 1, 2]` |  | `str` | `WzMsIDEsIDJd` |
| input:none | `null` |  | `str` | `Tm9uZQ==` |
| input:str | `"Hello World"` |  | `str` | `SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=` |

### basename

`basename(*args, **kwargs)`

Last name in a filepath

| Case | Input | Args | Result | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| input:bool | `true` |  | raises | `APIError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not bool` |
| input:dict | `{"b": 2, "a": 1}` |  | raises | `APIError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not dict` |

### yaql

`yaql(context, data, yaqlExpression)`

YAQL query language filter — pipe a Python value through a YAQL expression. $ refers to the piped value. Returns a list (not a generator). Common uses: filtering ($.where), projection ($.select), aggregation ($.len, $.sum).

_No live evidence yet: add a case to `jinja_filter_cases.yaml`._
